subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this vLLM Usage-page report stay in evidence-gathering until a current stream/transcript/API mismatch is shown, or should maintainers define a product default or warning for unpriced local-provider cost display now?
rationale: Current main already has the intended vLLM streaming-usage and Usage-page aggregation paths, while cost display for local providers depends on local pricing metadata and the unknown-pricing behavior is a product contract decision.

options.title: Collect Evidence First
options.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted current-main or latest-release vLLM stream, transcript entry, Usage API responses, screenshot, and pricing config before queuing code changes.

options.title: Route Cost-Only Gap To Canonical Issue
options.body: If token counts are present and only cost is blank or zero, handle the remaining behavior under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Sponsor Unknown-Pricing UX
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved warning or missing-cost UI contract for unpriced local providers, then implement it across providers rather than only vLLM.

recommendation.title: Collect Evidence First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a redacted current-main or latest-release vLLM stream, transcript entry, Usage API responses, screenshot, and pricing config before queuing code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to the vLLM streaming-usage fix, usage-cost accounting, and recent provider billing UI history.
